name: Monthly high breakout
description: Multi-timeframe price action on daily candles: buy when price closes above last month's high, ride it with a trailing stop.

about.how_it_works: Last month's high is a level long-term traders watch. A daily close above it means the market is breaking out on a higher timeframe. The trade uses daily candles for timing and the monthly level for direction. A 10% trailing stop lets a big trend run, and the position closes if price falls back below last month's low.
about.fails_when: Sideways years produce breakouts that fade. Expect few trades, a low win rate and occasional very large winners.
